title: Aging-associated extracellular signals
body:
Altered inflammatory, lymphangiogenic and matrix-related inputs
Examples: VEGFC–NRP2 • ANGPT2–TEK • VCAN–CD44

title:
Disease-associated microenvironmental
cues
body:
Disease-specific inflammatory, stromal and growth-factor signaling
Prioritized pathways include BMP/TGF-β/activin, PDGF,
VEGF, ANGPT, Notch and WNT

title: State-associated transcriptional regulators
Disease-associated transcriptional programs
body:
Regulon programs across DCM, HCM, DoxCM and HFpEF
SCENIC supports disease-specific transcriptional regulation

title: Aging-associated LEC state redistribution
body:
State 0 ↑
State 4 cytokine-responsive / immune ↓
State 5 matrix-interactive / structural ↓

title:
Shared and disease-specific LEC state
remodeling
body:
Cardiovascular diseases do not produce one uniform
pathological LEC state
Shared remodeling + disease-specific state changes

title:
Reduced adaptive inflammatory
responsiveness
body:
Impaired response to systemic inflammatory challenge
Influenza–plasma assay: young LECs adapt; aged LECs
show reduced tube formation and organelle remodeling

title: Lymphatic and cardiac remodeling
body:
Functional support: endothelial Acvr2a deletion in CMP models
Improved cardiac function • increased open lymphatic
vessels • no change in blood vessels
Independent spatial datasets provide tissue-level support for selected aging- and disease-associated LEC programs
